ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.65 low-intensity (black) to 0.35 high-intensity (white) across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pixels are concentrated in contiguous regions at the distal ends of both lobes. The proximal and medial regions consist of a continuous low-intensity black field with high-contrast mottled transition zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with visible slopes indicating an approximate 55-60 degree angle; the vertex point is occluded by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) are detected along the entire trailing edge boundary, isolated against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The leading edges of both lobes follow a distinct convex curve tapering toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, textured white/tan pixel blobs (barnacles) localized at the distal tips of both lobes; right tip shows a larger globular cluster.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple thin, light-colored linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the black pigmentation of the right lobe medial section.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization at both lobe tips and visible rake marks on the ventral surface of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular, jagged boundary pattern between black and white pigmentation on the left lobe distal-medial transition.
